about: Two Mega blocks examples, emitted by scripts/build-lesson-images.mjs's generateDebugC (the runner's own path) and compiled by stc-compiler (production 2de5ef8, target atmega2560, symbols:true), so test/mega-blocks-run.test.mjs can run them on the pinned engine with no network. The test re-generates the C from each example's program.bw and fails on any drift.
